summary.en: A watercolor butterfly life-cycle plate with four labelled stages and clockwise arrows.
summary.zh-CN: 用四个英文标签和顺时针箭头组织的水彩蝴蝶生命周期图谱。

prompt: Create an elegant natural-history field-guide plate showing the monarch butterfly life cycle, on warm ivory paper, with meticulous watercolor and fine ink detail. Four clearly separated stages arranged clockwise: upper left one tiny egg on the underside of a milkweed leaf; upper right a yellow-black-white striped monarch caterpillar eating milkweed; lower right a green chrysalis with delicate gold accents attached by its tip; lower left an adult orange-and-black monarch with white-dotted wing edges resting on milkweed. Thin unobtrusive clockwise arrows must connect egg to caterpillar to chrysalis to adult and back to egg. Exactly four labels: Egg, Caterpillar, Chrysalis, Adult. No other text. Show biologically plausible proportions and plant structures; avoid decorative butterflies or extra stages. Use only this standalone brief. Keep all outputs anonymous: no personal names, account data, contact details, signatures or references to any user. Generate the actual image, not a prompt or code.

steps: 在 Raphael 文生图界面选择 GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst。
粘贴原始提示词，不上传参考图，关闭 AI Enhance。
